mode_b_first_principles.what_this_business_actually_is: Four unrelated industrial businesses under a founder-controlled French holding company, renamed in early 2026: SFPI Access (ex-DOM Security — locks, cylinders, access control; 65% international, Germany-centric), SFPI Home (ex-MAC — French shutters/windows/garage doors/industrial closures), SFPI Air (ex-NEU-JKF — industrial ventilation and dust extraction), SFPI Heat (ex-MMD — plate heat exchangers and sterilizers: Barriquand, Steriflow, Cipriani). 4,011 employees, 56% France.

decisive_finding_1_profit_concentration.claim: SEGMENT-LEVEL FLOORING (house rule: aggregate floors hide mix erosion). The 4.1% group recurring-operating margin conceals that more than half the revenue earns nothing.
decisive_finding_1_profit_concentration.finding: Access + Heat = 46.9% of revenue and 101% of divisional profit. Home + Air = 53.1% of revenue and MINUS EUR 0.2M of profit. The group's 6.0% ROE is an artifact of welding two decent businesses to one structurally loss-making one.
decisive_finding_1_profit_concentration.authority: FY2025 results PR 15-Apr-2026 divisional table; corroborated by FY2024 URD Table 62 (revenue by pole) and H1-2025 interim report per-pole standalone P&L/balance sheets

A 71%-voting control shareholder has no obligation to stop it.

decisive_finding_3_pension_kills_the_hea.claim: The screen's EUR 74.8M net cash and 4.5x EV/EBIT ignore a EUR 51M UNFUNDED retirement obligation that both auditors flagged as a Key Audit Matter.
decisive_finding_3_pension_kills_the_hea.evidence: Audited FY2025 consolidated Note 13/14: retirement + long-service ('medailles du travail') provisions EUR 47,364k non-current (+ EUR 1,581k German representatives' rights) = EUR 48,945k non-current provisions; the joint auditors' KAM states the total retirement + long-service obligation is 'M EUR 51' against a EUR 549M balance sheet. Principally UNFUNDED German pension book reserves (DOM Sicherheitstechnik), French indemnites de fin de carriere, and long-service awards — a provision with no plan assets, i.e. debt-like.
decisive_finding_3_pension_kills_the_hea.arithmetic: Screen EV = 191.8 - 73.2 = EUR 118.6M -> 4.58x recurring EBIT. Honest EV (+ pension net of 25% French tax, EUR 38.3M) = EUR 156.9M -> 6.06x recurring EBIT / 7.26x reported EBIT. Net cash 'EUR 75M = 39% of cap' becomes ~EUR 35M = 18% of cap.
decisive_finding_3_pension_kills_the_hea.finding: The shelf's headline cheapness is overstated by 35-40%. This is the single most valuable non-consensus datum in the file and it runs AGAINST the name. Every Yahoo-derived net-cash screen in the market has the same blind spot.

correction_reported_faithfully.what_i_initially_found: SFPI has deposited a statutory annual financial report with the AMF every year 2016-2025, always in the last days of April. For FY2025 nothing appeared. I verified the feed was alive (299 OTHER French issuers filed periodic annual reports between 1 Apr and 9 May 2026) and noted the 15-Apr-2026 PR said the audit report was 'currently being issued'. I was on the way to a late-filing / audit-problem finding.
correction_reported_faithfully.the_disconfirming_check_that_broke_it: The FY2025 Rapport Financier Annuel EXISTS and is ON TIME — posted to the live issuer site www.sfpi-group.com on 2026-04-29 (statutory deadline 30 Apr). Audit reports on both the parent and consolidated accounts are signed 28-Apr-2026 at Neuilly-sur-Seine and Paris-La Defense by Grant Thornton and Ernst & Young Audit, UNQUALIFIED. The only emphasis is an 'Observation' on the prospective first application of French ANC Regulation 2022-06 — a presentation change affecting all French companies, not company-specific. Both 'avec reserve' hits in the document are boilerplate in the standard 'Responsabilites des commissaires aux comptes' section, not an actual qualification. Corroborated independently by the tape: the AGM of 18-Jun-2026 approved the accounts and the EUR 0.08 dividend went ex on 2026-06-23 — a French AGM cannot approve accounts without the statutory auditors' report.
correction_reported_faithfully.what_survives: A DISSEMINATION-CHANNEL lapse, not a non-publication. AMF General Regulation Art. 221-3 requires both website posting AND effective, full dissemination via a professional disseminator with filing to the AMF. SFPI satisfied the first limb and, for the first time in ten years, not the second. Materiality to an investor: LOW as a compliance matter, but it means the audited FY2025 accounts are INVISIBLE to every AMF-flux-driven screen and slow to reach data vendors.
correction_reported_faithfully.house_rule_applied: Asymmetric-error rule — trust cleans, scrutinise exclusions. The candidate EXCLUDE was scrutinised and it broke. Reported rather than buried.
correction_reported_faithfully.infrastructure_lesson: verticals/generators/auditor_late_filing_scanner.py is SEC/EDGAR-full-text-bound and structurally cannot see European issuers; euronext_shelf.py has no filing-timeliness gate at all. The free European equivalent is the AMF depository at info-financiere.gouv.fr (OpenDataSoft Explore v2.1, dataset flux-amf-new-prod, queryable by ISIN). Worth wiring as a recall-floor connector for the PAR/AMS/BRU/LIS venues — BUT this case proves the gate must fall back to the ISSUER WEBSITE before firing, or it manufactures false late-filing flags.

conservative_fv_reflex_check.too_low: My multiples are 50-60% of listed peers. At 10x Access / 11x Heat / 8x Air the SOTP is ~EUR 3.90. Anchoring a share-of-profit leader (Access, structurally growing security market) to a harsh smallcap multiple is exactly the documented error mode.
conservative_fv_reflex_check.too_high: I carry SFPI Home at zero rather than negative, and I assume Heat recovers EUR 7.5M -> 8.0M after a -21% revenue year. Both are live risks.
conservative_fv_reflex_check.resolution: EUR 3.22 central / EUR 2.33 bear brackets it honestly; I do not claim the EUR 3.90.

skeptic: '4.5x EV/EBIT' is wrong: ~6.1x recurring / ~7.3x reported once the EUR 51M unfunded pension is treated as debt.
'16% FCF yield' is wrong: 12.8% after lease principal, and CFO fell 18% YoY.
'39% of cap in net cash' is ~18% after tax-effected pension.
P/E 11.6x is not a deep-value multiple. ROE 6.0% at P/B 0.70 is FAIRLY priced on a P/B-x-ROE consistency test.
The cash cross-subsidises SFPI Home's losses indefinitely and a 71%-voting controller need never unlock the SOTP.
EUR 73k/day ADV means any position that matters cannot be exited.
Revenue has fallen three consecutive years; 'stable EUR 625-690M' is generator framing, not a fact.
blue_team: ROE 6.0% is depressed BY SFPI Home; ex-Home, group earnings are ~EUR 23M against ~EUR 259M equity and pre-tax ROCE on operating capital (stripping EUR 73M net cash) is 13.9%. Fair multiple for that ROCE is 8-10x EBIT, versus 6.1x paid — a real 1.3-1.7x gap.
SFPI Access alone plausibly exceeds the entire group EV.
The SOTP FLOOR (EUR 2.33 bear) sits above spot (EUR 2.08).
Guidance reaffirmed twice through a Deputy-CEO resignation; the September comp is the easiest in years.
default_reject_skeptic_pass.resolution: The gap is REAL but it is 1.3-1.7x, not 2-3x. It is PAID FOR by 24.7% float, EUR 73k/day liquidity, 71% family voting control, and a third of the business losing money. Those are real, bounded, unlevered, sleeve-cappable risks. That is the definition of RP_FAIR — ownable, but with no informational edge and no claim on calibration credit.

edge_classification.why_not_edge: No lie was found. Every decisive fact — the loss-making Home division, the EUR 51M pension, the falling recurring EBIT, the 71% voting control, the three-year revenue decline — is disclosed in the FY2025 press release, the H1-2025 interim report, or the audited RFA. There is no takeaway-vs-data divergence that clears the ELEVATE bar. Under house doctrine, re-detecting honestly disclosed bad news is not alpha.
